title: The Ascent Where Names Begin Falling

features.name: the raining names
features.desc-on-touch: Words fall around you like seed. Each one lands with meaning it did not have before. You can almost read them as they descend from the unnamed deep.

features.name: the ascending vowels
features.desc-on-touch: You climb past the place where language had no sound. Now the simplest names are taking shape—the first sounds that will never unsound themselves.

features.name: the threshold where meaning becomes form
features.desc-on-touch: Here the deep-names are becoming the shallow-names. What was true without sound is learning to speak itself into being. You stand at the edge of language.

features.name: the ground that receives the first words
features.desc-on-touch: The paddock here is empty and ready. It will hold the first true names that fall on it. It asks what they will mean when they land.

features.name: the witness tower
features.desc-on-touch: You climb here to watch names falling into form. The air is full of first-meanings. Everything that will be named is learning what it is called.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the moment the first names arrived between you
narr: you knelt in the empty field at the hour when language
becomes possible. she knelt beside you. around you the first
names were falling like dust or light or seeds—you could not
tell. you reached for one. she caught another. you both held
them without speaking. this is how words are born, she said.
by being caught before they forget they are true.

inscription: here the deep begins to learn it has always had a name; names are falling but have not landed yet; here is the threshold where the first sound will arrive
